meta.name: mem-search
meta.description: Search claude-mem's persistent cross-session memory database. Use when user asks "did we already solve this?", "how did we do X last time?", or needs work from previous sessions.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 搜索跨会话记忆数据库，快速找回历史工作
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要从之前的对话中找回解决方案或上下文
copy.tagline_en: Search cross-session memory database to quickly retrieve past work
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to recall solutions or context from previous conversations

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 查找过去会话时会分三步:先在跨会话记忆库里搜出带编号的索引,再查看相关时间线,最后只对你选中的记录取出完整内容。它不会一次性拉取全部旧记录,而是先过滤再取详情。
howto.when: 当你问起之前会话里的事,比如“我们之前解决过这个吗”“上次是怎么做 X 的”“上周发生了什么”等,就会触发。

say.text: 上次登录出问题我们是怎么解决的?
say.note: Claude 会去搜“登录”相关旧记录。

say.text: 我们之前是不是已经修过这个 bug?
say.note: 它会先列出候选索引,再等你确认。

say.text: 上周这个项目里发生过什么事?
say.note: Claude 会按时间线整理上周记忆。

howto.what_en: Claude searches past sessions in 3 steps: first an indexed list, then context around relevant items, then full details only for chosen IDs. It filters before fetching to save tokens.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks about previous sessions, e.g. 'Did we already fix this?', 'How did we solve X last time?', 'What happened last week?', or otherwise needs work from earlier conversations.

say_en.text: How did we fix the login issue last time?
say_en.note: It will search old records about login.

say_en.text: Haven't we already fixed this bug?
say_en.note: It will list candidate indexes for you to pick.

say_en.text: What happened in this project last week?
say_en.note: It will pull the timeline around last week.
